title: Cohere for VPs of AI: Vivek Muppalla
talk_summary: This is a Cohere enterprise sales pitch covering their Command R/R+ models, embeddings, reranker, and deployment options, with a short Q&A. The only genuinely transferable mechanism is the reranker-as-context-compressor idea: retrieve broadly, then cross-encoder rerank to shrink the context sent to the generative model, which cuts input-token cost.

takeaways.what_they_do: Retrieve a broad candidate set, run a cross-encoder reranker over it, and send only the top reranked documents into the generative model's context instead of the full retrieved set.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you were able to like narrow in uh to the right uh uh context and do that quickly, uh you could pass in very minimal amount of context

takeaways.technique: Prototype on general model, productionize on purpose-built small model
takeaways.what_they_do: Use an off-the-shelf generative model to get a use case working, then at production scale evaluate whether a cheaper purpose-built/specialized model is sufficient based on cost-of-operation and maintenance.
takeaways.evidence_quote: When you're trying to like productionize something, that's when I'd start thinking, "Hey, do I need a bespoke model or like the general model is good enough?"
